value.rationale: The exact maximum obstruction rank as a function of original Horn hypothesis atoms is a natural and previously only crudely bounded representation resource. The sharp \(B_h\) capacity captures a genuine order-convexity restriction while the matching acyclic Horn compilation proves the restriction is the only obstacle; for all \(h\ge1\), every individual context is feasible.
